# viettelcloud_placement_group (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud Placement Group by ID, name, region, or policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Lookup Placement Group by ID
data "viettelcloud_placement_group" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Lookup Placement Group by Name
data "viettelcloud_placement_group" "by_name" {
  name = "my-placement-group"
}

# Lookup Placement Group by Name and Policy
data "viettelcloud_placement_group" "by_name_and_policy" {
  name   = "my-placement-group"
  policy = "affinity"
}

# Lookup Placement Group by Region (returns the only matching Placement Group)
data "viettelcloud_placement_group" "by_region" {
  region = "vn-central-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Placement Group ID (UUID). Exactly one Placement Group must match.
- `name` (String) Placement Group name to filter by.
- `policy` (String) Placement Group policy to filter by: affinity, anti-affinity, soft-affinity, or soft-anti-affinity.
- `region` (String) Project region name where the Placement Group resides to filter by.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Placement Group was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Placement Group description.
- `project` (String) Project name owning the Placement Group.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID) backing the configured region.
- `server_count` (Number) Number of servers currently assigned to the Placement Group.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Placement Group was last updated (RFC3339).
